products.name: Oracle C2M SSO, SSL & Certificate/Keystore Configuration — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure the C2M security plumbing — SSO, SSL/TLS on WebLogic and C2M, and identity/trust keystores — so sign-in, endpoints, and trust are correct, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Secure C2M end to end: SSO, SSL, and keystores

C2M and WebLogic have to be secured properly — Single Sign-On, SSL/TLS, and the certificate keystores underneath — or you get broken logins, untrusted endpoints, and audit findings. This solution configures the C2M security plumbing: SSO integration, SSL/TLS on the WebLogic domain and C2M, and identity/trust keystore setup and management, pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M security model: SSO, SSL/TLS termination, and the identity/trust keystore chain on WebLogic.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (IdP for SSO, certificates/CA, WebLogic domain, C2M config).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure SSO, enable SSL/TLS on the domain and C2M, create/manage identity and trust keystores, wire certificates, and validate secure sign-in and endpoints, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (SSO works, SSL valid, keystores trusted) plus Best Practices for certificate lifecycle and key rotation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M secured end to end — SSO working, SSL/TLS valid, keystores trusted and managed — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MSEC-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of C2M/WebLogic keystores, SSL config, and advertised URL
    • OC2MSEC-Remediation.py — DRY-RUN-by-default WLST remediation of C2M/WebLogic SSL and keystore config
    • OC2MSEC-Report.py — read-only WLST coverage report of C2M/WebLogic security across the domain
    • OC2MSEC-ScopeHelper.py — read-only WLST helper that stages pilot vs domain scope for C2M security work
    • OC2MSEC-Validation.py — read-only WLST validation of C2M/WebLogic SSL, keystore, and SSO posture

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
